content.value: A T-section joist 200mm x 150mm x 30mm is used as a column of 4m long with one end fixed and the other hinged. Calculate the crippling load for the column. Take Young modulus for the joist as $2 0 0 \times 1 0 ^ { 3 } \mathsf { N } / \mathsf { m m } ^ { 2 } .$
